instagram.caption:
The pillows you move to sit down.
The Sofa and Seating Zone in the Living Room. Somewhere every person in the house can sit down without first moving something.

What done looks like:
1. Every seat on the sofa
2. Every armchair is sittable without lifting a single thing off it. Throws folded to one size in one basket
3. At most one cushion per seat left in place
4. Both remotes in the tray on the arm with batteries that work

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success sofa and seating zone.
